title: Code of Obligations (SR 220), Sixth Division, Art. 964a to 964c: transparency on non-financial matters
citation: Code of Obligations (SR 220) Art. 964a-964c, inserted by the Federal Act of 19 June 2020 (AS 2021 846)
evidence: Footnote on the chapter heading in the consolidated text of 2022-01-01: "Eingefügt durch Ziff. I und III 1 des BG vom 19. title: Ordinance on Climate Disclosures (Verordnung über die Berichterstattung über Klimabelange, SR 221.434)
evidence: Art. 6: "Diese Verordnung tritt am 1. Januar 2024 in Kraft." Opened https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/oc/2022/747/de/xml/fedlex-data-admin-ch-eli-oc-2022-747-de-xml.xml on 2026-11-02. Federal Council release of 23 November 2022 (https://www.sif.admin.ch/en/nsb?id=91859) says the same.
notes: SR number is 221.434 (the brief said 221.029). The XML metadata of the AS file shows jolux:dateEntryInForce 2023-01-01, which contradicts Art. 6; Art. 6 and the press release are used. Implements Art. 964a to 964c of the Code of Obligations (ch-co-art964a-c). The Ordinance refers to the TCFD recommendations; those documents are not stored. The as-adopted record and the 2024-01-01 consolidation both exist because their bodies differ (the consolidation drops the final provisions). Official English page, unofficial and not stored: https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/eli/cc/2022/747/en.
